criticalFindingDuringVerification.summary: While writing a real-SQL regression test for the chat-read gap, room creation itself (the very first step of every test) failed with 'new row violates row-level security policy for table rooms' — exposing a far larger, previously undetected bug: room creation has been completely broken for every user since the Rooms feature was introduced (20260920085000_kebu_rooms.sql).
criticalFindingDuringVerification.rootCause1: app/api/rooms/route.ts's POST handler creates a room with `.insert({...}).select('*').single()` — INSERT ... RETURNING. The rooms table's only SELECT policy, 'Members read rooms', was a bare `can_access_room(id)` call whose own body re-queries the rooms table for a row matching that id — the same table and the same row RETURNING just inserted, in the same statement. This is a real, independently confirmed upstream PostgreSQL defect (matches postgresql.org bug #19015: a function called from a SELECT policy does not see the row the current statement just inserted), not a local/PGlite-only artifact — reproduced first with a minimal, app-independent table outside any Kebu schema to isolate it from app-specific complexity, and corroborated by a public PostgreSQL bug report found via web search before concluding it was a real upstream issue rather than a sandbox artifact.
criticalFindingDuringVerification.rootCause2: Investigating further exposed a second, independent, even more severe bug: EVERY write to room_members — not just the RETURNING case — fails with 'infinite recursion detected in policy for relation room_members', including a room's own creator inserting their own first owner-member row during room creation (that specific call has no .select(), so the failure was silently swallowed with zero error check in the app code) and the 'member' action adding any second person to a room (which does check the error and would 500 every time). Root cause: the pre-existing 'Room admins manage membership' policy on room_members directly re-queries room_members itself (aliased `self`) to check the caller's admin role — a direct self-reference, the same recursion class already fixed for library_nodes/library_shares in the Oct 16 Library-sharing slice.
criticalFindingDuringVerification.whyInvisibleUntilNow: can_access_room()'s `created_by = auth.uid()` branch already gives a room's own creator full read/access without ever needing a room_members row to exist. So a solo room looked entirely functional end to end — the creator could use their own room normally — while no room_members row was ever actually created for anyone, ever, and no second person could ever be added to any room. The room-creation RETURNING failure (root cause 1) would have surfaced as a 500 on every single room creation attempt in a real deployment, which is the more immediately visible of the two, but both were latent together.
criticalFindingDuringVerification.verificationMethod: Both bugs were reproduced and confirmed to fail BEFORE writing any fix, using the actual migration SQL (not reimplementations) and, for bug 1, an additional minimal isolated repro table outside the app schema to rule out it being specific to the rooms table's particular complexity. Each fix was then verified to actually resolve the failure (not merely silence it), and to NOT weaken the existing authorization boundaries (stranger-read-denial and non-admin-cannot-add-member cases both still correctly fail after the fix).

fixes.roomCreationReturning: supabase/migrations/20261016161000_room_creation_returning_fix.sql — 'Members read rooms' now also has an inline `created_by = auth.uid()` disjunct (matching the pattern already used for library_nodes's 'owner_id = auth.uid() or ...' policy), which resolves the RETURNING-time check for a room's own creator without ever invoking the self-referencing function. can_access_room(id) remains for every other real (non-self-referential) read.
fixes.roomMembersRecursion: supabase/migrations/20261016162000_room_members_recursion_fix.sql — added `private.is_room_admin(room_id, user_id)` as a SECURITY DEFINER helper that reads room_members bypassing its own RLS, and rewrote 'Room admins manage membership' to call it instead of directly re-querying room_members from within room_members' own policy.
fixes.roomChatReadGap: supabase/migrations/20261016160000_room_chat_read_policy.sql — added the missing 'Room members read room channel messages' SELECT policy on space_messages for room-scoped channels, mirroring the shape of the existing room-scoped INSERT policy that was already there. Business-scoped chat (a separate, already-working branch) is untouched.
fixes.appCodeHardening: app/api/rooms/route.ts POST handler now checks the owner-membership and chat-channel inserts' errors (previously ignored for the membership insert, which is exactly how the recursion bug stayed invisible) and archives (there is no rooms DELETE policy; archived_at is the existing soft-delete convention, already excluded by this route's own GET and by can_access_room()) an incompletely-set-up room rather than returning success for a broken one.

realSqlPGliteTests.roomCreationReturning (tests/rooms/room-: confirms the regression is real without the fix (fails with the exact RLS error); the creator can create a room with the real app-code insert+select shape with the fix; a stranger still cannot read a room they don't belong to; a non-creator member still reads the room normally via can_access_room.
realSqlPGliteTests.roomMembersRecursion (tests/rooms/room-m: confirms the regression is real without the fix (fails with 'infinite recursion'); the creator can insert their own owner-member row with the fix; an owner can add a second member (the real 'member' action's case); a non-admin member still cannot add another member (authorization preserved, not just unblocked); a stranger reading the membership list sees nothing.
realSqlPGliteTests.roomChatReadPolicy (tests/rooms/room-cha: a non-creator room member can read room chat including their own and the creator's messages; a stranger cannot; a removed member loses chat-read access on the very next request; business-scoped chat (a different, pre-existing branch) is unaffected.
realSqlPGliteTests.total: 14 cases, all gated on KEBU_LOCAL_PGLITE_ROOT, applying the real migration chain verbatim, all 14 passed when run explicitly.

verifiedScenarios.mockedRouteTests: tests/rooms/rooms-route.test.ts (new, 6 cases) — first-ever test coverage for app/api/rooms/route.ts. Covers: successful room+membership+channel creation together; invalid payload rejection; room-insert failure; membership-insert failure triggers archive-and-fail rather than partial success; channel-insert failure triggers archive-and-fail; GET lists only unarchived rooms.
